snippet.title: GTA LC01 Lore #5: Victims & Victors
snippet.description:
Liberty City's reign of peace begins to crumble as the traditional criminal factions, the Italian crime families, have come under pressure from more powerful foreign players. This new looming threat forces warring factions to lay their differences aside and fight together for survival in an uneasy alliance. In this dynamic, however, there are victors and victims, rulers and the ruled, under partnerships amongst equals, with some more equal than others.

Meet Mick Hamfists, a feared enforcer and top hitman for the Leone Crime Family of many years, whose meeting with fate renders him on a completely different path in life. This is his story.
